title: Two-node VRRP VM test: promote, demote, fault, single-active units
description: Extend the multi-node VM harness (router-osv) with a two-router VRRP scenario and a WAN simulator: election, VIP move, delayed fail-back (preemptDelay), FAULT on LAN loss, reboot of the MASTER, singleActiveUnits start/stop, zoneReplication.ha promote/demote, and exclusive WAN ownership. Source: discussion 21 Q2/Q4. Acceptance: nix flake check runs it; it fails if both nodes hold the WAN or a zone as Primary.

title: router-ha: expose Keepalived GARP refresh options
description: Use Keepalived's built-in gratuitous ARP/NA (vrrp_garp_master_delay, vrrp_garp_master_repeat, garp_master_refresh) instead of arping/ndisc6 scripts proposed by the ecosystem plan. Measure convergence on Proxmox and the physical switch before tuning. Source: discussion 21 Q3.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: PR #154 exposes the options. Convergence measurement needs a live pair; do it during the nch-sny.36 rehearsal before tuning.

title: router-ha: typed single-active ownership; decide keaSync
description: The keaSync option (modules/router-ha.nix:196, opens port 8000) contradicts the documented single-active DHCP model. Decide: retire keaSync or make Kea HA real and tested. Model per-service VRRP ownership (Kea, DDNS, UPnP, RA, Technitium zones) as typed options in the zoneReplication.ha pattern rather than a static nodeMode. Source: discussion 21 Q3/Q4. Acceptance: one documented DHCP HA model; ownership assertions; VM test coverage via the two-node test.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: Kea HA made real and tested: branch feat/kea-ha-vm-test adds vm-router-kea-ha (load-balancing sync, failover to partner-down ~55-60 s, fail-back resync ~20 s, no duplicate leases), scopes HA port 8000 to the peer via router-firewall, retires router-ha.keaSync (warns, no longer opens 8000 on every interface), and fails eval if kea-dhcp4-server is in singleActiveUnits with Kea HA on.

title: router-ha: WAN promotion without restarting systemd-networkd
description: notify_master (modules/router-ha.nix:80) restarts systemd-networkd, bouncing LAN and management at the moment of failover. Replace with per-link control: the WAN .network uses ActivationPolicy=manual (always-down conflicts with networkctl reconfigure) and promotion runs networkctl up/reconfigure on the WAN only; demotion networkctl down. Verify DHCPv4 and DHCPv6-PD re-acquire on the pinned systemd. Source: discussion 21 Q3 (5/5). Acceptance: two-node VM test shows no carrier/address change on LAN or management during promotion and demotion; docs updated.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: PR #155 (VM test vm-router-ha-wan-failover). PD prefix may change on failover because the DUID differs per node; consider DUIDType=link-layer with the cloned MAC as a follow-up.

title: 98 Subnet Overlap, MTU & Topology Invariant Assertions
description: Implement pure Nix evaluation-time assertions in modules/lib/ip.nix and modules/router-networking.nix detecting overlapping prefixes, out-of-bounds DHCP pools, and MTU violations.
close_reason: Implemented pure Nix IP CIDR library, subnet overlap assertions, DHCP pool containment, VLAN MTU invariant, and VRRP VIP separation

title: router-ha: lower VRRP priority when the master's WAN fails
description: A failed networkctl reconfigure (or a dead upstream) leaves keepalived MASTER without a working WAN; nothing demotes it. Add a keepalived track_script/track_interface option (e.g. DHCP lease present + upstream ping) that lowers priority so the peer takes over. Raised by CodeAnt on PR #155 (modules/router-ha.nix:84). Needs a VM test: ISP stops answering on the master's WAN, peer takes over.

title: router-ha: VRRP auth secret as a file, no default password
description: vrrpPassword defaults to nix-router-ha and is rendered into keepalived.conf in the Nix store (modules/router-ha.nix:144-147, 274-279). Add vrrpPasswordFile (credential, rendered at runtime), deprecate the inline option with a warning, drop the default. Note VRRP PASS auth is weak by design; document that the LAN must be trusted. Source: discussion 21 Q4 (Claude). Acceptance: no secret in the store; eval check; migration note.

title: 95 Hardware Optimization Safety Matrix & LRO Removal
description: Purge hazardous lro on from modules/router-optimizations.nix, enforce safe GRO forwarding defaults, and implement driver-aware hardware offload capability negotiation and runtime status tracking in /run/router/nic-offload-status.json.
close_reason: Purged hazardous lro on, enforced safe GRO, implemented driver-aware capability negotiation and /run/router/nic-offload-status.json tracker

title: 96 Multi-Node NixOS VM Test Harness
description: Implement multi-node QEMU virtual integration tests in tests/vm/ validating DHCP, NAT, DNS, and zone drop policies across virtual nodes.
close_reason: Implemented multi-node QEMU VM test harness with wanSimulator, router, client, and iotNode verifying DHCP, NAT, DNS, zone isolation, and routerctl diagnostics

title: Correct and label the ecosystem plan and FreeBSD comparison
description: Discussion 21 found: ignores #144-#150, VIP shown live, X520 incident omitted; conntrackd -C (should be -c); RFC 9686 misattributed (IPv6-Only Preferred is RFC 8925); CARP 'identical' to VRRP (analogous; VRRPv3 is RFC 9568); '100% bit-identical'; unsourced performance numbers; overstated session-loss claims; OPNsense rollback outdated. Add a header 'research input; unverified where marked', fix the errors, and fold accepted items into the discussion 20 roadmap rather than a parallel plan. Acceptance: both docs corrected and linked from discussion 21.
close_reason: Revision 2 (2026-11-19) of ECOSYSTEM-RESEARCH-AND-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md adds an authoritative §0 (state, priorities, verdicts, corrections) and inline [rev 2] fixes; FREEBSD-OPNSENSE-COMPARISON.md corrected and dated. PR #151.

title: 99 Systemd Slice Isolation & Framework Rebranding
description: Introduce systemd resource slices with memory/CPU boundaries, rebrand framework identity away from RouterOS-like, and publish docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
close_reason: Defined router systemd resource slices, rebranded framework to topology-driven architecture, and published COMPATIBILITY.md

title: 97 routerctl CLI Diagnostics & Static Firewall Explainer

close_reason: Refactored router-diag into routerctl with subcommands, --json support, /etc/router/policy-manifest.json, and firewall explain
